$comment: Cryptographic modules per service (CMU-CSO-CMD, CMU-CSO-UVM, CMU-CSO-CAT). scripts/build-scg.py joins this with the deploy's inventory and publishes the per-service list inside /.well-known/secure-configuration-guide.json; it fails the build when the inventory holds a component type that is neither mapped here nor listed as using no cryptography. Every certificate number was read from NIST's CMVP pages on the date given; no number is typed from memory. AI-drafted 2026-11-05; for the operator's review.

not-published.name: Not published by AWS for this service path
not-published.status: AWS's FIPS page lists FIPS endpoints and module families but names no CMVP module for this path; treated as not validated (DEC-152).

sigstore.name: Sigstore Fulcio and Rekor (public-good instance), cosign client
sigstore.status: Not a CMVP-validated module. ECDSA P-256 (a FIPS-approved algorithm). Signs published evidence; protects no customer data.

services.protects: data in transit between users and the edge, including app sign-in tokens
services.configuration: Security policy TLSv1.2_2021 (TLS 1.2 or later, forward-secret AES-GCM suites); ACM certificate.
services.tenant_default: TLSv1.2_2021 on every request; no FIPS-validated viewer TLS option is offered for a distribution.

services.service: API Gateway HTTP API TLS (Silk Reeling)
services.protects: the app's API calls in transit (CloudFront to API Gateway)
services.configuration: HTTPS only; CloudFront connects with TLS 1.2 (origin_ssl_protocols).
services.tenant_default: HTTPS only; AWS's API Gateway FIPS endpoint covers the management API, not an HTTP API's execute-api endpoint.

services.service: Amazon Cognito user pool (Silk Reeling sign-in)
services.protects: app users' credentials and MFA secrets, tokens
services.configuration: Hosted UI over TLS; tokens signed by Cognito; user records encrypted at rest by Cognito.
services.tenant_default: The Hosted UI sign-in domain has no FIPS endpoint (AWS lists cognito-idp-fips for the API only).

services.protects: the keys that encrypt the app's Lambda environment and log groups, the alert topic, the runtime signing key and the DNSSEC key-signing key
services.configuration: Four customer-managed keys, automatic rotation enabled on the symmetric keys.
services.tenant_default: Every app data store that supports a customer-managed key uses one (Lambda environment, log groups).

services.protects: function environment variables at rest; the app's outbound TLS to Cognito's key endpoint
services.configuration: Environments encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn). Outbound TLS uses the Python runtime's own TLS library, which is not run as a validated module (DEC-152).
services.tenant_default: kms_key_arn set on the app function.

services.protects: application and gateway logs at rest
services.configuration: Every log group encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
services.tenant_default: kms_key_id set on every app log group.

services.configuration: Topic encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

services.protects: secret values at rest (none exist today: the app holds no secret since SCN-2026-006)
services.configuration: A secret, if added, is encrypted under a customer-managed KMS key; the app key's policy admits Secrets Manager use only through the service.

services.service: Amazon S3 (site, logs, CloudTrail, Terraform state)
services.protects: objects at rest; the site's public content, access logs, the audit trail, Terraform state
services.configuration: SSE-S3 (AES-256, AWS-managed keys); TLS-only bucket policies on the state bucket.

services.protects: the integrity of the audit trail (log file validation digests)
services.configuration: Management events; delivered to the CloudTrail bucket (SSE-S3).

services.protects: the integrity of the site's DNS answers
services.configuration: Key-signing key is an asymmetric customer-managed KMS key in us-east-1 (ECC_NIST_P256).

services.protects: CI's federation to AWS (token signature verification by AWS STS)
the authenticity of published evidence (keyless signatures); other external services carry no customer data
services.configuration: cosign sign-blob with a Fulcio certificate and a Rekor entry; verification pins the workflow identity.

no_cryptography.why: Software packages, page content, IAM policy documents and alarm or schedule definitions: inventoried components that provide no cryptographic service of their own.
